brief.question: Build only the tower-defense game embedded on the page (not the portal around it), as a playable web game.
brief.purpose: The person wants to play the mazing tower-defense game on its own.
constraints: Original game in the same genre with the same kind of mechanics and controls; no copied name, art, levels or look of the existing game
Static site in app/dist, no sideways scroll on phones
brief.done_when: A playable mazing tower defense: grid placement with path checks, 6 tower kinds with upgrades/sell, waves of varied creeps from two entrances, lives/gold/score, keys 1-6/0/U/S/Shift/Space, served at / and the four locale paths.

handoff: Built "Dédale Défense": an original maze-building tower defense in app/src (index.html, style.css, game.js). build.mjs copies it to dist/ and to the four locale paths plus /en/. Following the person's request, only the game was built; the portal page (menus, comments, ads) was left out on purpose. rebuild_check: every required claim holds, and the only gap is the low likeness to that portal page. There's a test hook, window.__game, with step(seconds). Balance was tested with a bot (scripts in /tmp/dtd-test2): Easy won, Normal reached wave 47, Hard reached wave 37. Ideas for next time: UI translations per locale path, sound, a challenge mode.
